typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		SiteAlias as string,
		PermanentAccess as decimal(18,0),
		TempBadges as decimal(18,0),
		Created as string,
		{Created By} as string,
		{Item Type} as string,
		Path as string,
		AccessMetricsInsertDate as date,
		ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(notConvertedectfunctiondatedatediff('month', AccessMetricsInsertDate, currentTimestamp()) == 0, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case1 derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName,
		YearMM = toString(year(AccessMetricsInsertDate)) + toString((month(AccessMetricsInsertDate) - 1)),
		ACZDate2 = addMonths(AccessMetricsInsertDate, 0)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Path as string,
		YearMM as string,
		UploadDate as string,
		Item_Type as string,
		AccessMetricsInsertDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ACZDate2 as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Created as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		PermanentAccess as integer,
		SiteAlias as string,
		Created_By as string,
		ID as string,
		TempBadges as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Path,
		YearMM,
		UploadDate,
		Item_Type = {Item Type},
		AccessMetricsInsertDate,
		ACZDate2,
		Created,
		ETLUser,
		PermanentAccess,
		SiteAlias,
		Created_By = {Created By},
		ID,
		TempBadges),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
